# Age Based ASC Calibration


libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(yaml)
library(xml2)

local_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "age")
# Historical YAML layout: set local_dir to the old study folder instead.

```

```{r}
files <- list.files(local_dir, pattern = "^trial-[0-9]+\\.xml$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
if (!length(files)) {
  files <- list.files(local_dir, pattern = "^run[0-9]+\\.ya?ml$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
}
if (!length(files)) stop("No trial-*.xml or runN.yaml parameter files found in local_dir")
config_runs <- as.integer(str_extract(basename(files), "[0-9]+"))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(config_runs))
files <- files[order(config_runs)]
config_runs <- sort(config_runs)
age_trial <- if (file.exists(file.path(local_dir, "selection.json"))) jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(local_dir, "selection.json"))$trial else max(config_runs)

read_age_config <- function(file) {
  if (grepl("\\.ya?ml$", file)) return(read_yaml(file))
  doc <- read_xml(file, options = "NONET")
  value <- function(node, name) xml_attr(xml_find_first(node, paste0("param[@name='", name, "']")), "value")
  groups <- xml_find_all(doc, "/config/module[@name='advancedScoring']/parameterset[@type='scoringParameters']")
  base_modes <- xml_find_all(doc, "/config/module[@name='scoring']/parameterset[@type='scoringParameters'][not(param[@name='subpopulation']) or param[@name='subpopulation']/@value='null']/parameterset[@type='modeParams']")
  list(
    advancedScoring = list(scoringParameters = map(groups, function(group) {
      list(age_group = value(group, "age_group"),
           modeParams = map(xml_find_all(group, "parameterset[@type='modeParams']"), function(mode) {
             list(mode = value(mode, "mode"), deltaConstant = as.numeric(value(mode, "deltaConstant")))
           }))
    })),
    base_constants = setNames(map_dbl(base_modes, ~ as.numeric(value(.x, "constant"))),
                              map_chr(base_modes, ~ value(.x, "mode")))
  )
}
configs <- lapply(files, read_age_config)

rows <- list()
k <- 1

for (runNum in seq_along(configs)) {
  scoring_parameters <- configs[[runNum]]$advancedScoring$scoringParameters

  for (groupNum in seq_along(scoring_parameters)) {
    age_group <- scoring_parameters[[groupNum]]$age_group
    mode_params <- scoring_parameters[[groupNum]]$modeParams

    for (modeNum in seq_along(mode_params)) {
      mode <- mode_params[[modeNum]]$mode
      asc <- mode_params[[modeNum]]$deltaConstant

      rows[[k]] <- data.frame(
        run = config_runs[runNum],
        age_group = age_group,
        mode = mode,
        asc = asc,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      k <- k + 1
    }
  }
}
df <- do.call(rbind, rows)

ggplot(df) +
  geom_line(aes(run, asc, colour = mode, group = interaction(age_group, mode))) +
  facet_wrap(~ age_group) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 20, by = 1),
    minor_breaks = NULL
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)

# YAML-only historical files contain deltas, so retain their existing base constants.
base_asc <- configs[[match(age_trial, config_runs)]]$base_constants
if (is.null(base_asc)) base_asc <- c(car = -1.13, bike = -1.73, ride = -1.39)

asc_table <- df %>%
  filter(run == age_trial) %>%
  select(age_group, mode, asc) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = mode, values_from = asc) %>%
  arrange(age_group) %>%
  select(age_group, any_of(c("car", "ride", "bike", "walk"))) |> 
  mutate(car_final = car + base_asc[["car"]], bike_final = bike + base_asc[["bike"]], ride_final = ride + base_asc[["ride"]])


kable(
  asc_table,
  digits = 3,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Age group", names(asc_table)[-1]),
  caption = "Age-specific alternative-specific constant corrections (utils).",
  label = "asc-corrections"
)


knitr::kable(
  asc_table |>
    select(
      `Age group` = age_group,
      Car = car_final,
      Ride = ride_final,
      Bike = bike_final
    ),
  format = "latex",
  digits = 3,
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Effective alternative-specific constants by age group. Walk is fixed at zero.",
  label = "age-asc"
) |> cat()
```

Age-Based Modal split.

```{r}
# Age-based modal split from the persons and trips output of each calibration run
modes <- c("walk", "car", "ride", "bike")
age_groups <- c("0-17", "18-29", "30-44", "45-64", "65-74", "75-84", "85+")

age_group <- function(age) {
  case_when(
    is.na(age) ~ NA,
    age < 18 ~ "0-17",
    age < 30 ~ "18-29",
    age < 45 ~ "30-44",
    age < 65 ~ "45-64",
    age < 75 ~ "65-74",
    age < 85 ~ "75-84",
    TRUE ~ "85+"
  )
}

persons_files <- sort(list.files(
  local_dir,
  pattern = "\\.output_persons\\.csv\\.gz$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
))
trips_files <- sort(list.files(
  local_dir,
  pattern = "\\.output_trips\\.csv\\.gz$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
))

output_run <- function(files) {
  parent <- basename(dirname(files))
  as.integer(ifelse(grepl("^run-[0-9]+$", parent), sub("^run-", "", parent),
                    str_extract(basename(files), "^[0-9]+")))
}
person_runs <- output_run(persons_files)
trip_runs <- output_run(trips_files)
stopifnot(!anyNA(person_runs), !anyNA(trip_runs), !anyDuplicated(person_runs),
          !anyDuplicated(trip_runs), setequal(person_runs, trip_runs))
if (!length(person_runs)) stop("Download the persons/trips outputs to plot age-based modal splits")
persons_files <- persons_files[order(person_runs)]
output_runs <- sort(person_runs)
trips_files <- trips_files[match(output_runs, trip_runs)]

simulated_age_split <- map_dfr(seq_along(persons_files), function(runNum) {
  persons <- read_delim(persons_files[[runNum]], show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(person, age) %>%
    distinct(person, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(age_group = factor(age_group(age), levels = age_groups))
  
  persons |> glimpse()

  trips <- read_delim(trips_files[[runNum]], show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(person, main_mode) %>%
    filter(main_mode %in% modes) %>%
    inner_join(persons, by = "person")

  trips %>%
    count(age_group, main_mode, name = "n") %>%
    complete(
      age_group = age_groups,
      main_mode = modes,
      fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    group_by(age_group) %>%
    mutate(
      run = output_runs[runNum],
      share = n / sum(n)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
})

# The reference file contains shares by distance group. Aggregate over distance
# and renormalize so that the four modal shares sum to one within each age group.
target_age_split <- read_csv(
  "/Users/jakob/git/matsim-gunma/resources/mode_share_per_group_dist_ref.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = recode(
      age,
      `0 - 17` = "0-17",
      `18 - 29` = "18-29",
      `30 - 44` = "30-44",
      `45 - 64` = "45-64",
      `65 - 74` = "65-74",
      `75 - 84` = "75-84",
      `85+` = "85+",
      .default = NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group), main_mode %in% modes) %>%
  group_by(age_group, main_mode) %>%
  summarise(share = sum(share), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  mutate(share = share / sum(share)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Put the target dots at the final calibration run for direct comparison.
target_age_split <- target_age_split %>%
  mutate(run = max(simulated_age_split$run))

ggplot(simulated_age_split) +
  geom_line(aes(run, share, colour = main_mode, group = main_mode)) +
  geom_point(
    data = target_age_split,
    aes(run, share, colour = main_mode),
    shape = 4,
    size = 2.5,
    stroke = 1.1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ age_group) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, max(simulated_age_split$run), by = 1),
    minor_breaks = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Calibration run",
    y = "Modal split",
    colour = "Mode",
    subtitle = "Lines: simulated shares; crosses: reference target"
  )

```

```{r}
# Stacked age-group modal split: reference, iteration 0, and final iteration
mode_cols <- c(
  car = "#0072B2",
  ride = "#009E73",
  walk = "#E69F00",
  bike = "#D55E00"
)

font_size <- 22

first_iteration <- min(simulated_age_split$run)
last_iteration <- age_trial
stopifnot(age_trial %in% output_runs)

modal_split_comparison <- bind_rows(
  target_age_split %>%
    transmute(
      age_group,
      main_mode,
      share,
      scenario = "Reference"
    ),
  simulated_age_split %>%
    filter(run == first_iteration) %>%
    transmute(
      age_group,
      main_mode,
      share,
      scenario = "Iteration 0"
    ),
  simulated_age_split %>%
    filter(run == last_iteration) %>%
    transmute(
      age_group,
      main_mode,
      share,
      scenario = "Last iteration"
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = age_groups),
    Mode = factor(main_mode, levels = c("car", "ride", "walk", "bike")),
    scenario = factor(
      scenario,
      levels = c("Reference", "Iteration 0", "Last iteration")
    )
  )

ggplot(modal_split_comparison, aes(age_group, share, fill = Mode)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  facet_wrap(~ scenario, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = mode_cols,
    breaks = c("car", "ride", "walk", "bike"),
    guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = font_size) +
  labs(
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Modal split (trip-based)",
    fill = "Mode"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
overall_trial <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(results_dir, "overall", "selection.json"))$trial
overall_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "overall", sprintf("run-%03d", overall_trial))
overall_persons <- list.files(overall_dir, pattern = "\\.output_persons\\.csv\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)

persons_base <- read_delim(overall_persons, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!str_starts(person,"commuter")) %>%
  mutate(age_factor = case_when(age <18 ~ "0-17", age < 30 ~ "18-29", age <45 ~ "30-44", age <65 ~ "45-64", age <75 ~ "65-74", age < 85 ~ "75-84", .default = "85+")) 
  # mutate(age_round = floor(age/10)*10) %>%

  filter(!str_starts(person,"commuter")) 


mode_share_v1_age_sex <- trips_base %>% 
  left_join(persons_base, by = "person") %>% 
  count(age_factor, sex, main_mode) %>%
  group_by(age_factor, sex) %>%
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("m", "f"), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    Mode = factor(main_mode, levels = c("car", "ride", "walk", "bike")),
    scenario = "Model v1"
  )|> rename(age_group = age_factor) |> select (-n)

mode_share_v1_age <- trips_base %>% 
  left_join(persons_base, by = "person") %>% 
  count(age_factor, main_mode) %>%
  group_by(age_factor) %>%
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Mode = factor(main_mode, levels = c("car", "ride", "walk", "bike")),
    scenario = "Model v1"
  ) |> rename(age_group = age_factor) |> select (-n)
```

with sex

```{r}
# Sex-specific modal split plots.
# The calibration outputs contain sex for each person. The reference file does
# not contain sex, so the overall reference shares are shown in both plots as
# a common benchmark rather than as sex-specific reference values.
simulated_sex_split <- map_dfr(
  unique(c(first_iteration, last_iteration)),
  function(run_to_use) {
    persons <- read_delim(
      persons_files[[match(run_to_use, output_runs)]],
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ) %>%
      select(person, age, sex) %>%
      distinct(person, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(age_group = factor(age_group(age), levels = age_groups))

    read_delim(
      trips_files[[match(run_to_use, output_runs)]],
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ) %>%
      select(person, main_mode) %>%
      filter(main_mode %in% modes) %>%
      inner_join(persons, by = "person") %>%
      count(age_group, sex, main_mode, name = "n") %>%
      complete(
        age_group = age_groups,
        sex = c("m", "f"),
        main_mode = modes,
        fill = list(n = 0)
      ) %>%
      group_by(age_group, sex) %>%
      mutate(
        share = n / sum(n),
        scenario = if_else(run_to_use == last_iteration, "Model v2", "Model")
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
  }
)

sex_modal_split_comparison <- bind_rows(
  simulated_sex_split %>%
    transmute(age_group, sex, main_mode, share, scenario),
  target_age_split %>%
    transmute(
      age_group,
      sex = c("m", "f")[1],
      main_mode,
      share,
      scenario = "Reference"
    ),
  target_age_split %>%
    transmute(
      age_group,
      sex = c("m", "f")[2],
      main_mode,
      share,
      scenario = "Reference"
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = age_groups),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("m", "f"), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    Mode = factor(main_mode, levels = c("car", "ride", "walk", "bike"))
  ) |> 
  filter(scenario != "Model") |> 
  bind_rows(mode_share_v1_age_sex) |> 
  mutate(scenario = factor(scenario, levels = c("Model v1", "Model v2", "Reference"))) 
  

plot_sex_modal_split <- function(sex_to_plot) {
  plot_data <- sex_modal_split_comparison %>%
    filter(sex == sex_to_plot)

  plot_labels <- plot_data %>%
    distinct(age_group, scenario)

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(scenario, share, fill = Mode)) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.85,
      position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = plot_labels,
      aes(x = scenario, y = 0.02, label = scenario),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "white",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5,
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_grid(
      . ~ age_group,
      scales = "free_x",
      space = "free_x",
      switch = "x"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = mode_cols,
      breaks = c("car", "ride", "walk", "bike"),
      guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = font_size) +
    labs(
      x = "Age Group",
      y = "Modal split (trip-based)",
      fill = "Mode",
      title = sex_to_plot
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      strip.switch.pad.grid = unit(-1, "lines")
    )
}
```

```{r}
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5,
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_grid(
      . ~ age_group,
      scales = "free_x",
      space = "free_x",
      switch = "x"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = mode_cols,
      breaks = c("car", "ride", "walk", "bike"),
      guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = font_size) +
    labs(
      x = "Age Group",
      y = "Modal split (trip-based)",
      fill = "Mode",
      title = sex_to_plot
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      strip.switch.pad.grid = unit(-1, "lines")
    )
}


mode_share_men_model <- plot_sex_modal_split_model("Male")
mode_share_women_model <- plot_sex_modal_split_model("Female")

mode_share_men_model
mode_share_women_model

ggsave("modal_split_men_model_ref.png", mode_share_men_model, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("modal_split_women_model_ref.png", mode_share_women_model, width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
files <- list.files(local_dir, pattern = "\\.ya?ml$", full.names = TRUE)
configs <- lapply(files, read_yaml)

rows <- list()
k <- 1

for (runNum in seq_along(configs)) {
  for (modeNum in seq_along(configs[[runNum]]$planCalcScore$scoringParameters[[1]]$modeParams)) {
    mode <- configs[[runNum]]$planCalcScore$scoringParameters[[1]]$modeParams[[modeNum]]$mode
    asc  <- configs[[runNum]]$planCalcScore$scoringParameters[[1]]$modeParams[[modeNum]]$constant
    rows[[k]] <- data.frame(run = runNum - 1, mode = mode, asc = asc, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    k <- k + 1
  }
}

df <- do.call(rbind, rows)

ggplot(df) + geom_line(aes(run,asc, col = mode))  + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,20, by = 1), minor_breaks = NULL)
```
